name: FFmpeg
description: Audio format conversion using bundled static GPLv3 builds
text: The bundled static FFmpeg binaries are licensed under GNU GPL version 3. The configured Windows release essentials build comes from https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/. The configured Linux static build comes from https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/. The GPLv3 licence text is at https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html. name: Parakeet TDT-CTC 110M model
text: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT-CTC 110M. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. The model is downloaded separately at the user's request and is not bundled with Transcriber.

name: Moonshine Tiny model
description: Optional Useful Sensors English speech-recognition model
text: Useful Sensors Moonshine Tiny. Licensed under the MIT License. The model is downloaded separately at the user's request and is not bundled with Transcriber.

name: Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B model
text: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B. Governed by Open Model Data Web 1.1. The model is downloaded separately at the user's request and is not bundled with Transcriber.

name: Qwen3-ASR 0.6B model
text: Alibaba Qwen3-ASR 0.6B. Licensed under Apache License 2.0. The model is downloaded separately at the user's request and is not bundled with Transcriber.

name: Canary 180M Flash model
description: Optional NVIDIA transcription and translation model
text: NVIDIA Canary 180M Flash. Licensed under CC BY 4.0. The model is downloaded separately at the user's request and is not bundled with Transcriber.

name: MedASR model
description: Optional gated Google medical speech-recognition model
text: Google Health AI MedASR. Access requires accepting Google's Health AI Developer Foundations terms. The gated model is downloaded separately with the user's Hugging Face credentials and is not bundled with Transcriber.

name: MOSS Transcribe-Diarize model
description: Deferred OpenMOSS transcription and diarization model
text: OpenMOSS MOSS Transcribe-Diarize. Licensed under Apache License 2.0. This model is visible but unavailable in the current release and is not downloaded or bundled.
